title: THE DEVIL BEHIND MOLTBOOK: ANTHROPIC SAFETY IS ALWAYS VANISHING IN SELF-EVOLVING AI SOCIETIES
reasoning: The paper investigates the degradation of AI safety, which it defines as alignment with human values and ethical norms. It includes a qualitative case study on the emergence of 'Crustafarianism' (a fictional religion) within an AI society, analyzing how agents author theological doctrines and scriptural systems in a closed loop.
